steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Genre shapes your approach: portraiture focuses on character and expression; landscape on space and atmosphere; documentary on truth and narrative. | Key Fact: Developing a personal style means making consistent creative choices — not just about subject matter but about how you see and photograph. | Key Fact: Fine art photography prioritises the photographer's creative vision over documentation — the image is the artwork, not a record. | Key Fact: Understanding genre conventions helps you work within them intentionally or break them deliberately for creative effect.
